name: Temp Sensor 1 Linearisation
desc: ADC-to-temperature curve for temperature sensor 1. Column 1 is the inverted raw ADC reading, column 2 the resulting temperature as (value - 40) degrees C. This is the calibration that defines what the sensor reads: editing it changes every temperature-dependent decision the TCU makes. Confirmed encoding.

name: Temp Sensor 2 Linearisation
desc: ADC-to-temperature curve for temperature sensor 2. Same encoding as sensor 1: column 1 inverted raw ADC, column 2 temperature as (value - 40) degrees C.
